note: A warm-up (part 3): the five-tone scale, Do up to Sol and back by step, as the five-note run (RUN_STAGES five, the first) at 40 bpm, a semitone higher each pass and 5 semitones under the voice's top; also on /learn/vocal-warm-ups and /learn/pitch-matching-exercises.

exercise.title: The five-tone scale, up and back
exercise.why: Five notes up to Sol and back down by step, a key higher each pass, so your voice warms up one small step at a time.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the run: the mic starts with it. Sing along on "oo": {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} {{4}} {{5}} and back down to {{1}}.
Each pass starts a semitone higher.
_Don't reach for high notes: let a pass go when its top stops feeling easy._
